# Tests the FIPS job does not run under Go's FIPS 140-3 module v1.0.0 (GOFIPS140=v1.0.0).
#
# Go's module v1.0.0 has no ML-DSA: crypto/mldsa.GenerateKey and NewPublicKey return "mldsa:
# unavailable in FIPS 140-3 Go Cryptographic Module v1.0.0". Every test below needs an ML-DSA or
# hybrid (ed25519+ml-dsa-65) key, usually through a shared fixture, and fails for that reason alone.
# They run in the other FIPS configurations (GOFIPS140=v1.26.0 and off, where ML-DSA works) and in
# the ordinary test jobs. Nothing else is excluded: a new test that needs ML-DSA fails the v1.0.0
# run until it is added here, in review.
#
# One entry per line: MODULE PACKAGE TEST[/SUBTEST]. MODULE is the module directory ("." for the
# root module), PACKAGE is relative to it. An entry without a slash skips the whole top-level test.
# An entry with a subtest skips only that subtest (for a test whose other subtests, such as the
# ed25519 ones, still run). .github/scripts/fips.sh check-excluded runs every entry under v1.0.0 and
# fails unless it fails with the ML-DSA error, so an entry that no longer applies cannot linger.
. ./audit TestAcknowledgeRecord_AcknowledgesExactlyTheNamedLeaf
. ./audit TestAcknowledgeRecord_MustComeAfterTheLeaf
. ./audit TestAcknowledgeRecord_RefusalsAndForgeries
. ./audit TestAppendRedactionRecord_ResignsAfterALostRace
. ./audit TestCAAlgorithmProfile
. ./audit TestCertDecisionKey
. ./audit TestEvidence_SealedOverDigestWithSizeLimitedSigner
. ./audit TestHybridComponentSharedWithStandaloneRefused
